Name: Forest Junimos
Author: KediDili
TagLine: Forest Junimos is a mod that adds junimos to the forest, to the place they keep. They'll dance, meep and wave hand to you!
Description:
Forest Junimos is a mod that adds junimos to the forest, to the place they keep. They'll dance, meep and wave hand to you!

    Things to know
-To be able to see junimos, you need to have met the Wizard. If not they should appear the next day after you met him.
-This mod is also mobile incompatible, since Custom Companions was a mod that was made after 1.5 update.

    Installation
-Install latest version of SMAPI ( https://smapi.io )
-Install latest version of Content Patcher ( https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/470174 )
-Install latest version of Custom Companions ( https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8626 )
-Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
-Run the game using SMAPI.
  
  Config Options
-"RecolorPalettes": When set to true, junimos will have matching colors with your recolor mod if its supported. Currently supports Starblue Valley, DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor, Rosier Colored Glasses and A Wittily Named Recolor with authors' permissions. (Except for Starblue Valley, since the author already has written down that usage of files is allowed to provide mod compatibility if you're not gaining money from this, which I don't.).

-"AllowSpritesheetChanges": When set to true, junimos will use vanilla sprites and change if any mod edits the vanilla Junimo spritesheet.

    If You Encounter A Bug
-Please upload your log to https://smapi.io/log and see the instructions there, then submit a bug report to this page and attach your log (and a picture, if it's something visual). I cannot help you without a log!!

   Additional Credit
-Shekurika (For helping me test the mod!)
